name: Ask for reviews and reply to them
summary: Asks customers for a review after a finished job, and drafts a reply to each review that needs one. Crons read, draft and queue only: a person approves every review request, and a person posts every reply, because the kit cannot post replies yet.

covered_by.job-complete: ask (completed_jobs, written by the business's job tool or the CRM shell)
covered_by.review-monitor: reviews (Podium only; GoHighLevel has no review read in the kit)
covered_by.request-message: platform (GoHighLevel workflow wording; Podium invite text is set in Podium)
covered_by.request-channel: platform (review link set on the platform; Podium invites carry it)
covered_by.reply-positive: draft (reply_drafts, read and posted by a person)
covered_by.reply-negative: draft (reply_drafts, flagged for a person); posting is not covered (see gaps)

crons.name: reviews
crons.summary: Reads the business's reviews from Podium and drafts a reply for each one that needs an answer. Nothing is posted.

crons.name: ask
crons.summary: Queues a review request for each completed job not yet asked. A person approves each one before it goes out.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a read of the reviews the business holds. Anything that sends a review invite, adds a contact to the review workflow (which sends the request), or tags a contact (which can start a workflow) is a live operation and waits for a person.

podium.covers: review read (drafts), review invite (queued for approval)

gohighlevel.covers: review request workflow and asked tag (queued for approval); no review read

gaps: Replies are drafted, not posted. Podium's reply operation (docs.post_reviews_uid_responses) needs {uid} in its path, but the kit maps no parameters for it, so the call cannot be built. GoHighLevel's send-review-reply needs a conversationId for each review, and the kit has no operation that lists the business's Google reviews. A kit change is needed for either one (core/ was not changed here).
Google Business Profile: no ops file in the kit, and the 30 pages fetched were Google Ads and Accelerate articles only. No review step is mapped.
Finished-job feed: neither platform's docs show a job-complete trigger. The ask cron reads completed_jobs from the store, so something outside this workflow must write them.
Podium contact search by tag: GET /contacts has no tag filter, so the kit cannot find job-complete contacts in Podium. Podium asks therefore come only from completed_jobs.
GoHighLevel contact search: the contact search body has no fields in the spec, so tagged jobs cannot be picked out automatically. Asks come from completed_jobs.
Reminder chase (second and third reminders): Podium is partial (its reminder text is cut off in capture) and GoHighLevel documents one day only. No chase cron is built.
Escalation: neither platform documents passing a poor review to a manager. A low rating is flagged in reply_drafts only.
Review monitor and alerts for new Google reviews on GoHighLevel: not documented and not mapped.
Both adapters are docs-only until a sandbox account (a Podium developer account, a GoHighLevel test sub-account) proves them.
